title: The office
caption: A weekday morning in 1985: two radio studios on the air, both offices full, the canteen ready for lunch.

title: TV studios
caption: Lunchtime on the second floor: the soap opera on the air from its pub, its cast at the bar, the sitcom studio with its audience seating, and two video editors in the editing room.

title: Kids and reality
caption: The kids' studio with its playroom, the reality house on the air with one of its cast in the confession booth, and the dressing room where the hosts are made up.

title: The writers' room
caption: Four writers at the long table under the story board, beside two offices on the fourth floor.

title: Teams
caption: How each team feels and when it last met. The sales team threatens to strike: their morale has been low for weeks.

title: The roof
caption: On top of the office: the antenna the company broadcasts from, and the satellite dish that came with the uplink.

title: The town
caption: The headquarters in Coaxia, the capital, with the streets, their traffic lights and the railway around it.

title: Building a room
caption: A new office being drawn on the second floor, beside a TV studio.

title: The cables
caption: The ground floor with its cables shown: from every studio, and from the control rooms of the TV studios upstairs, to the master control room and up to the antenna, all on the air.

title: Rooms
caption: Every kind of room, what it is for and what it needs, with the furniture that goes in it: here the master control room.

title: The schedule
caption: A day on a radio channel: who is tuned in to each slot and how well its show suits them, and the morning show beside it, with what it earns and why it draws what it draws.

title: A milestone
caption: Twenty years on the air: the game waits while the confetti falls, and Uncle Tabby sends money.

title: The ratings
caption: The radio and TV market of the week, against the public broadcaster and three rivals.

title: Sales
caption: Sponsor offers and running contracts. A sponsor you know pays more.

title: Licenses
caption: The map of Etheria and its five regions, each with its own audiences and licenses.

title: Research
caption: The research tree by decade, from game shows and FM stereo to streaming.

title: Finance
caption: The month ahead, the month so far and what the company is worth: ad revenue and what sponsors add apart, bills paid day by day, bought titles by the airing.

title: The office at night
caption: Eight in the evening, in the dark color scheme. Two shows are still on the air.

title: The home screen
caption: The broadcasting house under an evening sky.

title: A new game
caption: Choosing the region for the headquarters, with a live view of its town, and the difficulty, which sets the money and the rivals.

title: Uncle Tabby
caption: The first day of 1970: your uncle welcomes you to the company he paid for.
